title: Punk Witch with Lantern
description: A female punk character with bright red spiky hair stands in the center of a swirling vortex of dark clouds and fiery energy. She holds a glowing lantern in her left hand and a sheathed sword in her right, wearing a black leather jacket with red patches, an orange scarf, and has visible tattoos and an eye symbol on her forehead.
prompt: A fierce female punk with bright red spiky mohawk and pale skin stands dramatically against a swirling vortex of dark purple and teal clouds at sunset. She has an eye tattoo on her forehead, wears a black leather jacket covered in red patches over a red shirt with an orange scarf, fishnet stockings, and holds a lit ornate lantern in one hand while gripping a sheathed sword with the other. Dramatic cinematic lighting, fiery energy trails, dark fantasy style.
